structural_adapter.jacobian_isogeny: By the Klein-four Kani-Rosen relation, Jac(C) over Q(i) is isogenous to E x conjugate(E).
structural_adapter.rank_evenness: Complex conjugation identifies E(Q(i)) and conjugate(E)(Q(i)), hence rank Jac(C)(Q(i)) = 2*rank E(Q(i)) is even.
structural_adapter.quadratic_extension_decomposition: For K=Q(i), Jac(C)(K) tensor Q decomposes into +/- eigenspaces for Gal(K/Q). The + eigenspace is Jac(C)(Q) tensor Q and the - eigenspace is the Q-points of the (-1)-quadratic twist tensor Q. Therefore rank Jac(C)(K)=rank Jac(C)(Q)+rank Jac(Cminus)(Q).
structural_adapter.closure_trigger: If RankBound(Jac(C))<=1 and RankBound(Jac(Cminus))=0, then rank Jac(C)(Q(i))<=1 but is even, so it is 0. Consequently rank E(Q(i))=0.
